description: Dated, sourced corps commander schedule (command-loop proposal §5E, owner decision 3). Keyed by corps id; each tenure: officer_id, tenure_start, tenure_end (exclusive, null = to the end), historical_fate (survived | killed | relieved), source (ICTY first, then Balkan Battlegrounds). Turn = ceil((date - 6 Apr 1992) / 7 days). Populated pre-freeze by commander attribution PR 2c from the historian seat's table (2026-11-17); every ICTY date was read in the trial judgment. A boundary with no day-level source keeps the shipped availability turn. A corps or span with no sourced holder is left out, and the pool fallback fills it.
